rule.name: secrets-chat
rule.description: Applies to all modes. Never expose sensitive values in chat, logs, or outputs.
rule.secrets_and_chat: Never echo, log, or paste sensitive values to chat (e.g. VERACODE_API_KEY, SONAR_TOKEN, passwords, API keys, tokens, secrets). Only report that a credential is "set" or "NOT SET" or that an operation succeeded or failed. Do not paste log files that may contain credentials or tokens (e.g. sonar-scan.log, veracode-scan.log) to chat; report only success/failure or summary. Applies in every mode: orchestrator, qa, secure, code, plan, deploy, and all others.
